title: Hedgehog in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g id="hedgehog">
    <!-- body/spines as lit dark purple -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#6B4C8A"/>
    <!-- spine texture spikes -->
    <g fill="#8B6BB0" stroke="none">
      <polygon points="22,58 16,50 26,54"/>
      <polygon points="26,46 20,38 32,44"/>
      <polygon points="36,42 32,32 44,40"/>
      <polygon points="48,40 48,30 56,40"/>
      <polygon points="60,42 64,32 68,44"/>
      <polygon points="70,48 78,40 76,52"/>
      <polygon points="74,58 84,54 78,64"/>
      <polygon points="30,56 22,62 30,64"/>
      <polygon points="66,56 76,62 68,66"/>
    </g>
    <!-- face/body light area -->
    <ellipse cx="44" cy="68" rx="20" ry="15" fill="#F5D9B8"/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx="28" cy="70" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#F0C9A0"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx="20" cy="70" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="#3B2A4A"/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx="38" cy="64" r="3" fill="#3B2A4A"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="63" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- ear -->
    <ellipse cx="46" cy="58" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#E8B88A"/>
    <ellipse cx="46" cy="58" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#C98E6A"/>
    <!-- scarf -->
    <path d="M30,76 Q44,82 58,76 L60,82 Q44,88 30,82 Z" fill="#E84A4A"/>
    <path d="M36,78 Q44,82 52,78 L54,83 Q44,86 35,82 Z" fill="#C42E2E"/>
    <!-- scarf tail -->
    <path d="M56,80 Q66,84 68,92 L62,94 Q58,86 52,84 Z" fill="#E84A4A"/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx="36" cy="86" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#D9A06A"/>
    <ellipse cx="52" cy="86" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#D9A06A"/>
  </g>
</svg>
